verdict.rationale: Exa documents a search API that takes natural-language queries and returns ranked web results, including a deep-reasoning search mode, and one hands-on user was impressed with the search API. The evidence never explicitly describes the ranking as embedding- or meaning-based, and nothing shows it finding results keyword engines miss. Older Metaphor-era feedback shows mixed semantic relevance. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of semantic/embedding-based retrieval, a comparison showing results keyword search misses, and independent benchmarks of semantic relevance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run meaning-based semantic search that finds results keyword engines miss

citations.quote: Exa Search is a web search API that takes a natural language query and returns ranked web results with clean page content.
Search the web in natural language and get clean, relevant page content in one request.
Exa has custom search types with appropriate latency-quality profiles, from ~250 ms instant search to 12-40 second deep-reasoning search.
